# StackCut

> StackCut helps individuals and small teams review recurring software
> subscription costs, identify possible overlaps, and estimate annual spend.

## Official pages

- Homepage: https://stackcut.site/
- App: https://stackcut.site/app
- International tax calculator: https://stackcut.site/tax-calculator
- Pro and checkout: https://stackcut.site/pro
- Privacy: https://stackcut.site/privacy
- Rocket Money comparison: https://stackcut.site/vs/rocket-money

## What StackCut does

- Offers a 30-second calculator for three user-entered subscriptions.
- Annualizes costs based on selected billing intervals.
- Lets users import supported CSV records or enter subscriptions manually.
- Highlights possible overlap candidates with explanations for review.
- Provides an international software-subscription tax estimator with
  limited automated reference-rate coverage.

## Privacy and limitations

- Subscription records are stored in a passphrase-encrypted browser-local vault.
- CSV files are parsed locally by the app.
- Specific features make server requests, including Pro entitlement checks
  and tax-rate lookups.
- The quick calculator does not upload or save the values entered into it.
- Similar names or categories are heuristic signals, not proof that two tools
  are interchangeable.
- Potential waste is not guaranteed savings; users decide what to cancel.
- Tax amounts are estimates, not tax advice or confirmed vendor invoice charges.

## Plans

See https://stackcut.site/#pricing and https://stackcut.site/pro for the
